$comment: Pangolin design tokens. The only place token values live. After editing, run: python3 design/tools/generate_tokens.py (writes core/designsystem/.../PangolinTokens.kt). CI fails if the two disagree. Decided values: PRD section 7 and docs/design/brief.md.

bodySm.use: Host under a title, supporting text

bodyMd.use: Compact tile row title, dialog body

titleMd.use: Pill switch, tile title, list row title

TINT_ALPHA_BLUR.doc: Tint opacity over a blurred page.

TINT_ALPHA_NO_BLUR.doc: Tint opacity where the page shows through without blur (API 30, or no blur capable view).

BlurRadius.doc: Blur radius of the page behind the bars (RenderEffect, API 31 and later).

FIELD_DARKEN.doc: How far the address field's tone moves from the bar tint: toward black on a light bar.

FIELD_LIGHTEN.doc: How far the address field's tone moves from the bar tint: toward white on a dark bar.

DISABLED_ALPHA.doc: Opacity of disabled bar icons (not held to a contrast minimum, as WCAG allows).

TRACK_ALPHA.doc: Opacity of the progress line's track.

SELECTION_ALPHA.doc: Opacity of the text selection highlight in the address field.

TINT_FADE_MILLIS.doc: Length of a tint change between sites: the short fade (motionFadeShort).

ToolbarHeight.doc: Height of the bottom toolbar, without the navigation bar inset.

FieldSlot.doc: Width of the page menu and the reload or stop slots inside the address field.

ProgressStroke.doc: Stroke of the field's waiting arc and of its progress line (unified address bar plan, section 4).

ARC_LENGTH_FRACTION.doc: Length of the waiting arc as a share of the field outline.

ARC_LAP_MILLIS.doc: One lap of the waiting arc around the field, linear.

ACCENT_SOFT_MIX.doc: How far the waiting arc's accent moves toward the field (dark bar) or white (light bar) before the 2:1 check.

L_LAYOUT_MIN_DP.doc: Smallest window width and height, in dp, that uses the unfolded L layout (unfolded L layout plan, L1).

RailWidth.doc: Width of the navigation rail of the L layout (plan L3).

DockedBarWidth.doc: Width of the docked address bar of the L layout, capped at the window width minus the gutters (plan L4).

DockedBarPadding.doc: Padding between the docked address bar's pill and its field (64dp pill around the 52dp field).

EdgeGutter.doc: Space between the screen edge and the rail or the docked address bar, at the side and the bottom.

RailGap.doc: Space between the rail and the docked address bar below it, and between the rail and the page or its menus.

RailDividerMargin.doc: Space above and below the rail's divider, besides the 4dp between controls.

SWAP_ENTER_MILLIS.doc: Length of the rail's and the docked bar's entry on the new side during a swap (emphasized decelerate; the exit is motionExit). Unfolded L layout plan, L7.

SWAP_ENTER_AT.doc: How far out the leaving rail and bar are when the ones on the new side start to come in, so exit and entry overlap. Unfolded L layout plan, L7.

CompactBarHeight.doc: Height of the compact bar, the floating domain pill the bars collapse into while the page scrolls down (D19). Fully round; grows with the font scale.

CompactBarPadding.doc: Space between the compact bar's ends and its domain text (D19).

CompactBarStroke.doc: Hairline around the compact bar so it reads over a page of the same color as its tint (D19).

COMPACT_OUTLINE_ALPHA.doc: Opacity of the bar content color in the compact bar's hairline (D19).

CompactBarBottom.doc: Outer screen: the compact bar sits centered this far above the bottom of the window, and never over the navigation bar (D19, frame Outer A).

CompactBarDockedBottom.doc: Inner screen: the compact bar sits in the docked bar's corner this far above the bottom of the window, and never over the navigation bar; EdgeGutter from the side (D19, frame Inner A).

COLLAPSE_SCROLL_DP.doc: The bars collapse once the page has scrolled this many dp down since the last change of direction (D19, browser basics plan section 4).

EXPAND_SCROLL_DP.doc: The collapsed bars expand once the page has scrolled this many dp up since the last change of direction (D19).

COLLAPSE_CONTENT_OUT_END.doc: Collapse progress by which the full bar's buttons and field have faded out: they go first, then the material narrows to the pill (D19).

COLLAPSE_PILL_IN_START.doc: Collapse progress from which the compact bar's domain fades in, until it is fully shown at 1 (D19).

CARD_ASPECT.doc: Width to height of a tab tile's card, in both modes and at every column count.

LabelGap.doc: Space between a tile's card and its label row (letter badge and title).

StripHeight.doc: Minimum height of a preview tile's header strip at 2 columns. Grows with font scale.

StripHeightCompact.doc: Minimum height of a preview tile's header strip at 4 columns. Grows with font scale.

SelectionStroke.doc: Width of a selected tile's border (borderSelected).

SelectionGap.doc: Page colored gap inside a selected preview tile's border, so the border reads against any picture.
